Privacy Policy

Draft for owner review. This policy is not final. Public signup remains disabled until business details, contact information, and policies are approved.

Version: draft-2026-10-19

Who operates this website

The website operator is Eleven Forward (business identity pending). Privacy questions and withdrawal requests can be sent to [Public contact email to be supplied before launch].

Information submitted with signup

If you choose to sign up, the form sends your email address, selected product interests when using the product form, consent choice, the consent wording and policy versions, and a fixed website source identifier. When JavaScript is available, it also sends a client-provided submission time. That time is not independently verified. We do not ask for your health information.

How signup information is used

We use signup information to provide product updates and exclusive deals and to keep a record of the consent associated with your signup. Signing up does not require you to share your ostomy status or any other health details.

Service providers

Cloudflare hosts this website and may process technical request information to deliver and protect it. Form submissions are sent to Web3Forms and delivered to the designated Eleven Forward inbox. Web3Forms and the inbox provider process information needed to handle and deliver those submissions. Their own privacy notices describe their processing practices.

Cookies and tracking

This release does not add analytics, advertising trackers, or marketing cookies. Hosting and form providers may process technical information for service delivery and security.

Retention

[Owner must approve a retention schedule before launch.] Signup records and consent evidence are stored in the designated inbox. The retention schedule must address active signup records, withdrawal requests, and the minimum information retained to prevent further marketing after withdrawal.

Withdrawing consent and privacy requests

You can request withdrawal, access, correction, or deletion by emailing [Public contact email to be supplied before launch]. We will handle requests according to applicable requirements. A minimal suppression record may be retained to honor a request not to receive further marketing. Marketing campaigns must include a working unsubscribe process before campaign sending begins.

Changes

Updates to this policy will be published here with a new version identifier. We will communicate material changes as appropriate.
